summary: DICE's first-person parkour series; use PC for fidelity, preserve the mobile prequel separately, and note Catalyst's discontinued online/social features.

entries.title: Mirror's Edge
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release plus PS3 exclusive map cleanup

emulation.notes: Use PS3 only for the exclusive map.

primary.why: The PC version has the highest fidelity ceiling and supports Nvidia PhysX effects, but the PS3 version has a sourced exclusive Time Trial map.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version with the seven shared Time Trial DLC maps; play the PS3 exclusive Time Trial map separately if you want every challenge map.

secondary.exclusive_content: One PlayStation Store-exclusive Time Trial map.
secondary.what_to_play: Play only the PS3-exclusive Time Trial map after the PC main game/DLC.
secondary.why: The PC version is the fidelity pick, but the PS3 version has one exclusive map.

entries.title: Mirror's Edge

emulation.notes: No current official store route documented.

primary.why: The mobile Mirror's Edge is a distinct side-scrolling prequel; the iPad release has the fuller presentation and split-screen multiplayer compared with iPhone.
primary.how_to_play: Play the iPad version only if already preserved; it was removed from the App Store in 2015.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern port documented; app delisted.

entries.title: Mirror's Edge Catalyst
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release for offline campaign

primary.why: Catalyst released on PS4, Xbox One, and Windows; PC is the highest-fidelity route, but EA shut down online/social features in December 2023.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version for the single-player/open-world campaign; expect asynchronous online/social features and related achievements to be unavailable.

entries.remaster_caveats: No expanded edition documented; servers shut down.
